gaps.explanation: Proprietary funds statement of receipts, disbursements and changes in net position - cash basis (p6) prints Water, Sewer and Ambulance columns; no business-type lines in detail[]. Statement receipts[] = Charges for Services (Water+Sewer 300,256 as Utility Charges, Ambulance 30,353 as Ambulance Fees) + Miscellaneous Receipts 4,382 + Interest Income 3,723. Water: 206,870 + 4,382 + 2,135 = 213,387; Sewer: 93,386 + 1,304 = 94,690; Ambulance: 30,353 + 284 = 30,637. 213,387 + 94,690 + 30,637 = 338,714 = statement total.
